fusions.name: Mud Heave
fusions.desc: Heaves a mass of earth into the target, dealing 14 damage, knocking it 3.5 tiles back and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Clod Volley
fusions.desc: Looses 3 clods of silt in a spread, each dealing 3 damage.

fusions.name: Dug-In Pit
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to dig a pit that stays armed for 30 seconds. The first enemy to come within 2 tiles sets it off, and it deals 16 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Burrow In
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 35%, a shield worth 20% of your maximum health closes over you for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
